title: ASCII Decode
text: Parse ASCII character vector into Simulink values, 1 input, 1 output, {Format string} sets Format specifier for parsing input vector; {Number of variables} sets the number of output ports for this block and {Variable types} sets the simulink data types allowed for output. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: D
ports.summary: Input vector to parse character vector
Numbered ports that send Simulink ® values numeric

params.name: Format string
params.values: Format specifier for parsing input vector %d\r (default) | %c | %i | %o | %u | %x | %e | %f | %g

params.name: Number of variables
params.values: Number of output ports for this block 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Variable types
params.values: Simulink data types allowed for output ports {’double’} (default) | {’int8’} | {’uint8’} | {’int16} | {’uint16’} | {’int32’} | {’uint32’}
